python3 -c "
import json, pandas as pd
r = json.load(open('/app/conflicts.json'))
assert r['total_conflicts'] == len(r['conflicts']), 'total mismatch'
df = pd.read_parquet('/app/merged_users.parquet')
assert list(df.columns) == ['user_id','name','email','created_date','status'], df.columns
assert df.user_id.dtype == 'int64' and set(df.user_id) == {101,102,103,104}
row101 = df[df.user_id==101].iloc[0]
assert (row101['name'], row101['email'], row101['created_date'], row101['status']) == ('John Doe','john@a.com','2024-01-15','active'), 'priority wrong'
import re
assert all(re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', d) for d in df['created_date'])
for c in r['conflicts']:
    assert isinstance(c['user_id'], int) and c['user_id'] == 101
    assert set(c['values']) == {'source_a','source_b','source_c'}
    assert c['values']['source_a'] == c['selected']
print('ALL CHECKS PASSED')
"
